Role Description

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agentic Ads Experience team, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered product experiences that change how advertisers work with Reddit Ads Platform. You will own features end-to-end: framing the problem, choosing the right combination of software, LLM calls, tools, orchestration, and guardrails, and driving them through rollout, measurement, and refinement. The ideal candidate is a strong product-focused software engineer with hands-on generative AI application experience, who has an opinionated point of view on where agents, workflows, skills, and retrieval belong, and who cares deeply about shipping reliable systems that advertisers actually trust.

Responsibilities:

Product Execution: Design and ship advertiser-facing AI features and platform (campaign assistants, creative generation, audience discovery, performance analytics, optimization recommendations) end-to-end, from prototype to GA.

Agentic Systems Design: Make the right architectural calls on if and how to use generative AI, whether it’s a single-shot LLM call, a workflow, a skill, a retrieval system, an agent loop, human review, or no AI at all.

Reliability and Guardrails: Build for the failure modes of LLMs — structured outputs, tool/action boundaries, retries, cost controls, tracing, evals, and human-in-the-loop where it matters.

Measurement: Define offline and online evals, instrument traces, run A/B tests, and connect model and product metrics to advertiser and business outcomes.

Safety and Trust: Design for data isolation, permissioning, auditability, and policy compliance when AI systems take action on behalf of advertisers.

Collaboration: Partner closely with PM, Design, Data Science, ML Platform, Trust, and sales/ops to turn ambiguous problems into concrete, shippable systems. Collaborate with other product teams on how best to expose their services and capabilities to the platform’s centralized agent(s).

Craft and Communication: Write clear design docs, explain trade-offs to non-engineers, and raise the bar on how the org ships gen AI features.

Required Qualifications:

5+ years of experience as a software engineer, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems.

Hands-on experience building generative AI applications: structured outputs, function/tool calling, prompt and context design, RAG, model routing, and handling model failure modes.

Genuine enthusiasm for agents and LLMs — you follow the space closely, have opinions on the tools, and can talk shop about the evolving ecosystem.

Strong systems fundamentals: APIs, distributed systems, queues, data stores, service ownership, auth, idempotency, retries, and observability.

Experience defining evals and measurement for AI systems — offline datasets, online metrics, and knowing when and how to measure a launch quality bar.

Fluent with AI coding tools and code-assistant workflows as part of your day-to-day engineering practice.

Excellent communication skills. You can collaborate effectively in a remote environment and explain complex AI system trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Extensive software development experience in one or more general purpose languages: Python, Golang, Rust, Java, JavaScript, etc.

Bonus Points:

Experience in Ads, marketing technology, marketplaces, growth, recommendations, search, or analytics.

Experience building AI systems where mistakes are expensive: customer-facing products, regulated workflows, policy review, payments, or high-scale infrastructure.

Experience building internal workflow automation for sales, ops, support, policy, trust, or engineering productivity.

Tech Lead Applied Scientist
Samsara
Remote - US

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's AI has helped prevent accidents that would have harmed an estimated 380,000 people per year. Every model we ship runs in the real world, on real roads, protecting real drivers. 

This is the most senior individual contributor role on our Safety AI team. The role is focused on taking models from research to production in safety-critical systems.

You'll sit at the intersection of cutting-edge computer vision research and production systems that run across millions of IoT devices globally. The models you build run on the edge, in real time, on the trucks and vans and heavy equipment that keep the world moving.

Scale: Millions of AI dash cams, 100B+ miles/year (~99% of U.S. roads), 25T+ data points

Problems: Driver behavior understanding, 3D scene reasoning, and long-tail event detection in real-world environments

Stack: Modern vision models (e.g. transformers), large-scale training pipelines, and optimization for edge inference on constrained devices

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. 

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will: 

You will be the technical thought leader and you will lead the design and implementation of our most critical Safety AI initiatives including real-time perception systems that run across millions of edge devices in the physical world and the cloud. The scale and constraints make this an extremely unique applied ML problem. You will:

Architect end-to-end computer vision pipelines for real-world safety detection — object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation, multi-camera fusion, and beyond

Drive the technical roadmap for edge and cloud perception, including how we optimize and deploy models on constrained hardware without sacrificing accuracy

Partner closely with our hardware and firmware teams — we build our own devices, which means you'll have a rare ability to co-design the full stack

Work with petabyte-scale multimodal data (video, sensor, telematics, diagnostics) to train and iterate on production models

Stay at the frontier of CV and perception research and translate what matters into shipped product

Mentor and technically guide senior scientists and engineers across the team

Bring clarity to ambiguous problems — translating customer and business needs into precise, solvable engineering challenges.

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Vision, or a related quantitative field.

10+ years as a scientist or ML engineer, with experience leading end-to-end AI systems in production.

Deep expertise in computer vision (e.g., object detection, tracking, segmentation) for real-world environments.

Experience with multimodal perception and sensor fusion (e.g., camera, lidar, radar, GPS/IMU).

Experience with transformer-based architectures and vision-language models (VLMs/VLAs).

Experience building and deploying real-time or edge ML systems optimized for low-latency inference.

Demonstrated ability to drive systems from research through production deployment, including performance optimization and reliability at scale.

An ideal candidate also has:

Experience applying perception to real-world systems such as driver assistance, fleet safety, or operations automation.

Publications or patents at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, NeurIPS).

Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
Elastic
United States

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team.  This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you’ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.

What You Will Bring:

Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You bring proven knowledge in building and operating sophisticated search platforms and engineering robust, high-performance software systems.

Experience mentoring expert engineers, providing both technical and professional guidance.

Experience defining a long-term technical vision for a core search or retrieval system, working across teams and organizations to collaboratively shape the technical roadmap.

Hands-on experience with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, or Solr,

Strong skills in core Java and familiarity with advanced data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features like lambdas. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.

Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.

Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Collaborating across distributed teams is challenging, we value being supportive, empathetic, and trusting in all interactions, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.

Bonus Points

You've built things with Elasticsearch before, and you have experience in the search and information retrieval space and understand the constructs and theory behind it.

Experience working with open source projects and familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

Software Engineer - Product Platform Security
Rubrik Job Board
Palo Alto, CA

About the Team & Role

The Platform Security Engineering team builds the security features and frameworks that every Rubrik product runs on protecting hundreds of petabytes of data across thousands of enterprise customers globally, from encryption and certificate management to access control and platform hardening at scale. We're a small team with massive impact: the problem space covers the entire Rubrik portfolio, from performant core backend architecture to the AI-powered engineering workflows we and the rest of Rubrik now build with daily.

This is a strong opportunity for new grads and early-career engineers who want real ownership on security-critical systems. You'll help solve problems like:

How do we roll out post-quantum cryptography across the backup data path before it's an industry requirement?

How do we let customers manage sessions and access against compromise, at enterprise scale?

How do we build an access control engine that holds up against dynamic, customer-defined policies unique to a data management platform?

How do we secure the AI agents and agentic developer workflows that are now embedded in how Rubrik engineers ship code?

You'll work alongside experienced engineers and deeply technical managers who will mentor you as you grow, on a roadmap with genuine business impact.

 

What You'll Do

Security feature development

Design and steer AI to write clean, well-tested code in Go, Scala, or Python for scalable, secure platform services.

Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions.

Identify attack surfaces and build solutions to harden Rubrik products.

Triage, debug, and drive product/system issues to resolution with clear ownership.

Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as a core part of your daily engineering, while learning to treat AI-generated code as untrusted input that gets the same security scrutiny as any other contribution.

Security code and design reviews

Review code and design docs from other teams to flag security concerns before they ship.

Help extend our review practices to cover AI-powered features and AI agents as they become part of Rubrik's product surface.

Contribute to secure coding guidelines and evangelize them across engineering.

Team collaboration

Partner with Product Management, UI/UX, docs, InfoSec, and support to turn security requirements into shipped features.

Participate in planning, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.

 

How We Build and Secure with AI

AI isn't a side note for this team, it's part of the job on both sides:

As builders: you'll use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your normal workflow, the same way the rest of Rubrik engineering does.

As security engineers: you'll help define what "secure" means for AI-generated code, AI-powered features, and autonomous agents acting inside Rubrik's infrastructure, an active, fast-moving part of our roadmap.

 

What We're Looking For

Required

Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

0-2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, and bootcamps count).

Strong fundamentals in at least one language (Go, Java, Python,  C++, or similar) and in data structures, algorithms, and testing.

Genuine interest in security, curious about how systems break and motivated to build things that don't.

A proactive, self-directed learning style; comfortable asking questions and diving into ambiguity.

 

Preferred

Coursework, personal projects, or internships in cybersecurity, cryptography, or systems security.

Comfort with Linux/Unix, Git, and basic networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS).

Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar).

Interest in open-source security tooling or the broader security community.

What Makes a Great Candidate

Beyond the qualifications above, the traits that predict success on this team:

Thinks critically - can analyze problems and reason through potential security implications, not just implement what's asked.

Collaborates well - enjoys working with others and learning from teammates across disciplines.

Pays attention to detail - understands that small details matter in security.

 

Growth & Mentorship

You'll be paired with senior engineers who invest directly in your growth. Over time, expect to build real depth in:

Applied cryptography, secure protocol design, and threat modeling.

Distributed systems, API design, and system-level security testing.

Security code review — spotting vulnerability patterns in both human- and AI-written code.

Technical communication, documentation, and (as you grow) mentoring others yourself.

 

We back this with a dedicated mentorship program, regular tech talks and learning sessions, and support for security conferences and training.

Why Join Shield Platform?

The best entry point into security engineering we know of: direct ownership on mission-critical production systems that safeguard Fortune 500 enterprises and critical infrastructure worldwide, mentorship from veteran security architects, and a forward-looking roadmap spanning post-quantum cryptography to AI agent security that puts you at the absolute forefront of enterprise security engineering.

As a Staff Enterprise Security Engineer, you will be a technical leader within the EntSec team, responsible for the foundational security posture of our organization. You will serve as an SME on the technical strategy and engineering execution for securing the AI ecosystem in our Enterprise, moving beyond policy into building the foundational "decision infrastructure" and technical guardrails that allow the enterprise to innovate with AI at scale.

You will need a background in security engineering and the cross-functional influence necessary to solve ambiguous, large-scale problems. Leveraging expertise in security assessments,  threat modeling, identity and access control principles, and data protection, you will architect and build preventative guardrails and mitigate new risks introduced by first and third-party AI agents in our Enterprise.

Design and implement secure reference architectures for Enterprise AI platforms that secures every Twilion’s engagement with them, ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and resilience against evolving AI threats.

Establish a definitive framework for AI vetting, driving the cultural and policy shifts needed to institutionalize this strategic mindset across the organization.

Collaborate with cross functional partners to develop and set the long term roadmap for agentic AI identity and posture management, ensuring cohesive strategies for reducing risk from agentic AI use.

Proven track record of designing and deploying complex security systems at scale.

Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Go, or Java.

Experience in building, deploying and reviewing automation for complex security workflows, including use of both AI-driven and traditional automation tools.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI security risks to non-technical stakeholders.

Site Reliability Engineer (Senior or Staff), Storage Layer Services (SLS)
MongoDB
Boston; Miami; New York City; Pittsburgh; Raleigh; United States

MongoDB’s Storage Layer Services (SLS) team is re-architecting the MongoDB cloud storage layer and sits at the heart of our next-generation cloud storage architecture. This relatively new team is building performant, multi-tenant distributed storage services that both enhance today’s Atlas storage stack and enable more customer workloads to run more efficiently.

You will partner with the teams building these storage services to define SLOs, shape capacity plans, and ensure the reliability, durability, and operational safety of the storage layer that underpins Atlas. You’ll join a small, senior team of SREs as founding members of this organization, playing a crucial role in executing on a multi-year roadmap for MongoDB’s cloud storage architecture.

This role can be based out of our Boston, New York City, Raleigh, Miami, Pittsburgh or remotely in the United States while physically based in an Eastern or Central time zone location. 

The ideal candidate should

Have 6+ years of experience working on software development and operating distributed systems

Proficiency in Python, Go, or a similar language

Have operated or supported stateful storage or database systems at scale, and are comfortable with durability, consistency, and recovery trade-offs.

Possess a customer-focused mindset

Value efficiency in processes and operations

Prefer automation over manual processes. We are a small team of software engineers with a strong bias towards software solutions to avoid toil

Experience using and extending containerization technologies, particularly Kubernetes, to enhance application agility, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate time-to-market

Expertise in cloud infrastructure platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Azure

Understanding of Linux operating system internals and networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing)

Responsibilities 

Work on our multi-tenant distributed storage systems, balancing long-term strategic infrastructure goals with immediate engineering needs

Build for reliability, making services and infrastructure available, resilient, fault-tolerant, and self-healing

Identify and configure key metrics to detect incidents and quantify service health, availability, and performance

Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to resolve issues involving the storage infrastructure

Become an expert in infrastructure performance, helping us optimize from the application level all the way to the kernel

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

Leading major architectural shifts, such as moving from legacy storage stacks to new multi-tenant storage architectures, including planning and executing large-scale data and workload migrations with tight availability and durability requirements

Managing and scaling infrastructure across multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Designing secure, multi-tenant runtime environments at scale

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

The core of Mixpanel’s value to customers has always been great data. Talk directly to customers and prospects to understand how their data infrastructure and workflows are changing, and translate that into product bets

Build the business case for infrastructure-level investments, making the ROI of foundational, long-horizon work legible to leadership

Define how Mixpanel's data model, governance, and metadata need to evolve to support deeper analysis and a growing product portfolio

Align engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a shared strategic point of view, with clear, written communication

Dropbox

Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.

Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.

Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.

Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.

Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.

Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.

Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.

Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.

Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.

Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.

Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.

Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.

Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.

Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

Production experience with FleetDM on Windows, including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps.

Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results.

Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms.

Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools, and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls.

Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux.

Data & Analytics

Accordion's Data & Analytics and Engineering team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

We deliver agentic workflows, and solutions designed to streamline processes and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

This role can be based in any of our US office locations and has the potential for client travel to be onsite. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

About the Role and You

We're looking for a rare combination: a data scientist who thinks like a strategist and a strategist who speaks fluent data. You fall in love with problems and quantify complex situations using math. This isn't a role in building models in isolation—it's about transforming how a business makes decisions, identifying opportunities, and driving growth. You'll be an equal parts analyst, advisor, and architect of our strategic direction.

What You’ll Do

You'll sit at the intersection of data and strategy, turning complex business challenges into quantifiable opportunities. This means diving deep into our numbers to surface insights that others miss, then translating those insights into actionable growth strategies. You'll work directly with leadership to shape major business decisions, from market expansion and pricing strategy to resource allocation and competitive positioning.

Your day-to-day will involve identifying the right questions to ask before anyone else thinks of asking them, building the analytical frameworks to answer those questions, and presenting recommendations that fundamentally shift how we operate. You'll own strategic initiatives from conception through execution, measuring impact and iterating as you go. You’ll travel to client sites as needed, leading AI assessment and Strategy Engagements.

What We're Looking For

The Strategic Mindset: You naturally think several moves ahead. You understand business models, competitive dynamics, and growth levers. You can walk into a room with executives and hold your own in discussions about market strategy, unit economics, and long-term planning. You've seen how businesses succeed and fail, and you know how to spot the difference.

The Technical Depth: You're genuinely strong in quantitative methods—statistics, predictive modeling, optimization, and experimental design. You can wrangle messy data, build robust analyses, and know when a sophisticated model is needed versus when a simple calculation will do. Python, R, and SQL are still in your wheelhouse.

The Translation Layer: You can explain complex analytical concepts to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing them down. You know how to build conviction around data-driven recommendations and can defend your methodology when challenged. You make the quantitative accessible and actionable.

The Business Acumen: You understand P&Ls, growth metrics, customer economics, and operational levers. You've worked closely enough with business teams to know what keeps them up at night and how your analyses can help them sleep better.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in data science, engineering or data engineering roles with increasing strategic responsibility

Strong foundation in data platforms, data science, statistics, machine learning, and quantitative analysis

Additional considering will be given to engineers who have a background in data but have yet to work deeply with LLM enabled workflows

Experience working directly with business leaders to convey options and tradeoffs to define solution design and scope.

Demonstrated experience influencing business strategy through data

Track record of identifying and driving growth opportunities

Excellent communication skills with technical and executive audiences

Proficiency in modern data science tools and languages

Understanding of business finance and growth frameworks

Ideal Background

You might come from management consulting or technical consulting with deep analytical chops, a curiosity for working on business problems, strategic roles at high-growth companies, corporate strategy teams with hands-on data work, or data science roles where you've grown into strategic advisory. What matters most is that you've successfully used data to change how businesses operate and grow.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you'll have identified three major strategic opportunities we weren't seeing before, built the analytical infrastructure to evaluate them rigorously, and driven at least one to implementation with measurable business impact. You'll have become a trusted advisor to leadership and the person they turn to when facing the company's thorniest strategic questions.

Show Us Your Influence

We want to see how your enthusiasm for AI translates into discoveries other people use. If your résumé references that you are leading or contributing to AI product communities on Discord, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, X, or other platforms, please include your handles, profile or community links, and specific examples of your contributions. You live and breathe frontier AI. You’re testing new releases, pushing agents beyond their obvious uses, and discovering possibilities you can’t wait to show other people. This is how you spend your time because you love it. You’ve already brought others along through a community, channel, blog, or the conversations where people turn to you for ideas and advice.

In this role, you’ll immerse yourself in the product, uncover unexpected applications, and show people how to get more from its capabilities. You’ll connect with other enthusiastic users, build on their discoveries, and turn individual experiments into ideas and resources that inspire broader adoption. 

You’ll bring firsthand knowledge of what users are building, what they’re discussing, and where the product could go next. Your insights should introduce the team to possibilities they haven’t explored and help translate emerging user behavior into meaningful product opportunities. 

Your background might be in product, engineering, creative technology, education, content, community, or another discipline. What matters most is your demonstrated ability to explore AI deeply, share what you discover, and get others involved.

You may already be a power user of this product, or bring deep experience with another frontier AI agent and the curiosity to quickly become one. • Build on your existing product knowledge and experiments, exploring new features, integrations, and agent capabilities as they emerge. 

• Expand the practical, creative, and unexpected use cases you’re already discovering, bringing the team into what you’re testing and learning. 

• Push beyond established examples to uncover new workflows and applications, collaborating with Product and Engineering to explore their potential. 

• Turn the discoveries you already share into compelling demos, tutorials, posts, and reusable resources that reach more people. 

• Bring your ongoing immersion in frontier AI into the team’s thinking, sharing emerging capabilities, relevant developments, and informed user perspectives. 

Inspire and Connect Users 

• Deepen the conversations and relationships you already have in Reddit threads, Discord channels, and other spaces where AI enthusiasts exchange ideas and build together. 

• Extend the trust you’ve earned through useful contributions, firsthand product knowledge, and helping others experiment. 

• Bring inventive users and compelling projects to the team’s attention, connecting people who could learn from or collaborate with one another. 

• Build on the ways you already get others involved through shared experiments, demonstrations, challenges, and collaborative activities. 

Qualifications
• Several years of being the product geek who tests every release, finds the unexpected use case, and gets everyone else saying, “Wait, how did you do that?” Your experience with frontier AI may be more recent, but your instinct to explore runs deep. 

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI agents or advanced AI platforms, including building tools, executing complex workflows, or automating tasks beyond conversational prompting. 

• A portfolio of projects, demos, tutorials, workflows, or public contributions that demonstrates product fluency and inventive applications.

• Ability to create clear, compelling content that helps users understand capabilities, reproduce use cases, and get more value from a product. 

• Experience identifying user needs, product limitations, and emerging behaviors, and translating those observations into actionable recommendations. 

• Practical knowledge of using agents, bots, integrations, or automation to support community participation and reduce repetitive work. 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage enthusiast communities authentically and collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and Marketing. 

• Ability to independently prioritize work, test ideas, follow through on commitments, and adapt as product capabilities evolve. 

Direct experience as a power user of the product is strongly preferred. Deep experience with another frontier AI agent or platform is also relevant. A formal community management title is not required.

New York

About MAIA 

MAIA is our next leap in AI, an always-available assistant that amplifies human insight. By integrating directly into our workflows, it turns AI into true Augmented Intelligence, extending our creativity, judgment, and expertise. Built on a multi-agent framework, MAIA connects specialized tools, data sources, and reasoning systems through one interface, so you can do more, think deeper, and deliver sharper outcomes for clients. 

About the Role

The Senior Product Manager for the AI Foundry team will own the execution, delivery, and continuous improvement of MAIA — Prophet’s internal multi-agent AI platform. Working from the strategic direction set by the AI Center of Excellence, you will translate high-level ambition into shipped product capabilities, measurable adoption, and trusted AI experiences. 

This role requires product judgment, technical fluency, delivery discipline, and AI systems thinking. You will partner closely with engineering to evaluate feasibility, shape architecture tradeoffs, define acceptance criteria, and ensure MAIA is reliable enough for real consulting work. You will help determine what should be built, how it should work, and whether it is good enough to ship.

 

Your Day to Day

Roadmap, Delivery & Team Leadership — Own the product backlog and release cadence from planning through launch. Assess technical feasibility and architecture tradeoffs so leadership can make informed prioritization decisions. Define acceptance criteria grounded in user value, system constraints, and release quality. Lead day-to-day execution of the Foundry product team — unblocking work, setting priorities, and driving momentum through ambiguity. 

Technical Credibility & Engineering Partnership — Maintain hands-on technical involvement — building prototypes, reviewing code, and running experiments. Partner with engineering on specifications, sprint execution, QA, release sign-off, and architecture decisions. Comfort with Python, LLM tooling, agent frameworks, APIs, and data schemas is expected. 

AI Evaluation, Quality & Observability — Define how MAIA capabilities are evaluated before and after launch. Create testing protocols for agent accuracy, hallucination risk, tool use, latency, and reliability. Build benchmark sets, red-team scenarios, regression tests, and release gates. Monitor production performance — failure rates, cost, user drop-off — and translate telemetry and incident data into product fixes and roadmap priorities. 

Experimentation & Technical Tradeoff Analysis — Design and run experiments to test new agent capabilities, benchmark model performance, and translate results into go/no-go recommendations. Evaluate approaches such as RAG, knowledge graphs, agent orchestration, API integration, and model selection against complexity, cost, latency, accuracy, and maintainability. Present clear recommendations with explicit tradeoffs and a bias toward shippable solutions. 

Agent, Workflow & Application Development — Gather high-value use cases from consulting teams and translate them into agent specifications, workflow diagrams, tool requirements, and acceptance tests. Manage the agent lifecycle from prototype through production, including prompt design, testing, monitoring, and deprecation. Support client-facing applications by coordinating feature requirements and contributing to implementation. 

Data, Security & Governance — Work with IT, security, legal, and business stakeholders to ensure MAIA handles enterprise data responsibly. Define requirements for permissions, access control, auditability, and user-facing guardrails. Ensure new capabilities are designed with trust and governance in mind from the start. 

Adoption, Enablement & Value Tracking — Drive adoption across consulting teams by understanding real workflows, shaping onboarding, and creating feedback loops. Define and report metrics for adoption, task completion, time saved, output quality, cost-to-serve, and business impact. Use these insights to prioritize improvements and communicate progress to CoE leadership. 

Stakeholder Communication — Tailor communication to the audience. Prepare technical demos, architecture documentation, release notes, and status updates. Interface with stakeholders across design, engineering, consulting, marketing, IT/security, and external partners. 

Product Sense & UX Quality — Champion the end-user experience. Hold a high bar for UI/UX quality and articulate specifically what’s working, what isn’t, and what you’d change. 

What You Bring

7+ years in product management, with at least 2 years in a technical product environment (AI/ML, platform products, developer tools, enterprise software, or data products). Consulting or consulting-adjacent experience is a strong plus. 

Demonstrated technical ability — can read and write code (Python preferred), navigate APIs, data schemas, and developer environments, and hold your own in engineering discussions. 

Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, agents, or AI workflow tools — including prompt engineering, model evaluation, RAG systems, tool calling, or structured outputs. 

Strong understanding of AI product evaluation — can define quality for probabilistic systems, create test cases, identify hallucination or reasoning failures, and set release criteria. 

Experience with enterprise data and integration patterns — APIs, databases, permissions, authentication, and workflow integrations. 

Operational product discipline — production monitoring, incident triage, QA, release management, and continuous improvement from telemetry and user feedback. 

Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity, remove roadblocks, and hold people accountable without micromanaging. 

Excellent communication — clear specifications, confident presentations to technical and business audiences, message calibrated to the room. 

Experience building or managing internal AI tools, productivity platforms, or workflow automation products. 

Experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, knowledge graphs, agent orchestration, or LLM observability tools. 

Experience with secure enterprise environments — SSO, RBAC, audit logs, data privacy, or vendor review. 

Experience in consulting, professional services, or financial services. 

Track record turning prototypes into production products with clear success metrics and adoption plans. 

Familiarity with Python, TypeScript, React, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, vector databases, Jira, GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, or similar stacks. 

This is a hybrid role in our New York office and requires being in person 3+ days per week.

Accordion Intelligence Lab

The AI Lab is composed of leading software and AI engineers, designing agentic-AI solutions ahead of the market. Our group builds and operationalizes the AI systems that power Accordion’s consulting capabilities, from agentic architectures and RAG pipelines to evaluation frameworks and production observability.

The Lab works closely with practice leaders to translate research findings into scalable, reliable tools that advance Accordion’s AI-driven value creation work for PE clients and their portfolio companies.

About the Role

This posting covers three levels: Staff Software Engineer, Senior Staff Software Engineer, and Executive Director, Software Engineering. We’re hiring the engineers who set the technical bar for how AI Lab builds — not just shipping an agentic system end-to-end, but deciding how every pod builds agentic systems: which orchestration patterns get reused, what “production-ready” means for an eval framework, and when a client problem needs a genuinely new architecture rather than another RAG pipeline.

You’ll operate at the intersection of hands-on engineering and technical leadership. Expect to spend real time in the code and real time in the room with CFOs and PE operators defending the call you made. This is a highly technical role at every level in this posting — technical depth is the qualifying bar, not a management-track substitute for it. You will be expected to ship fast, defend your decisions, and continuously raise the bar on what AI-assisted delivery looks like.

What You’ll Do

Architect and ship the hardest agentic systems in the portfolio — multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure for PE-backed portfolio companies

Set technical standards and reusable patterns (orchestration frameworks, structured-output contracts, eval methodology) that other pods adopt across client engagements

Own build-vs-buy and architecture trade-off decisions, and defend them to technical and non-technical audiences, including CFOs and PE operators

Build and evolve the observability and evaluation infrastructure that keeps production AI quality measurable firm-wide, not just pod-by-pod

Mentor and technically develop other engineers through architecture reviews, paired work on hard LLM problems, and code review

Travel to client sites as needed to scope, present, and stand behind the work

At the Senior Staff / Executive Director level: represent AI Lab’s technical point of view in cross-practice and client-executive conversations, and identify where the Lab should build new capability ahead of demand

Success in the First 6 Months

Shipped or materially improved a production agentic system serving a real client engagement

Introduced at least one pattern, tool, or standard that another pod has adopted

Built credibility with client stakeholders and internal leadership as someone who can be handed the hardest, most ambiguous technical problem in the room

Established or improved evaluation infrastructure so regressions are caught before a client sees them

What You’ll Bring

Demonstrated technical ownership of a production agentic AI system with real users or clients — not a notebook, not a demo, not a POC that never shipped

Deep fluency in agentic architecture: multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, structured output, and evaluation/observability, with real opinions on the trade-offs between approaches

Strong Python and TypeScript/React fundamentals, with the judgment to know when a framework is the right call and when it’s just glue code

A track record of translating ambiguous client asks into shipped systems on compressed timelines — ideally in a consulting, professional-services, or boutique AI-consultancy context

Genuine daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) in your own workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t

Comfort setting technical direction for engineers beyond your immediate team, and defending that direction to skeptical stakeholders

Nice to Have

Finance/PE domain experience: FP&A, GL data, ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP), or portfolio-company operating workflows

Public technical work James and the Lab leadership can review: GitHub, open-source contributions, technical writing

Experience building multi-tenant tools or platforms reused across multiple clients

Prior experience formally mentoring or growing other senior engineers

This is a high-velocity environment. Sprints are short, client expectations are high, and we don’t slow down between engagements. If you’ve spent time in large enterprise engineering organizations where velocity is constrained by process, this will feel different.

The people who thrive here are those who find the pace energizing, not exhausting. They ship fast because they’ve internalized good judgment—not because they cut corners. They set a technical bar for others, use AI tools to multiply their own output, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and course-correct quickly when something isn’t working.

MBA Consultant (2027 Grads)
Keystone
Boston, New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, Washington D.C.

Keystone is a premier economics, technology, and strategy consulting firm built to help companies lead through transformation. As breakthrough innovations reshape industries, redefine competition and change our society, complex and highly competitive ecosystems emerge. Keystone advises technology leaders, Fortune 100 companies, their legal counsel, and governments on business, economic, litigation, and regulatory strategy in relation to these innovations and competitive eco-systems. We operate globally from offices in New York City, Boston, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Dubai, and Washington, D.C.

About The Role  

As an MBA Consultant, you are a versatile strategist who will own analytical workstreams, adapt quickly across problem types, and synthesize insights for high-stakes decision-making. Keystone teams are interdisciplinary, and you will work across a wide range of problems and practice areas.   

During the interview process, we assess your ability to apply your core skillset to unfamiliar questions and operate effectively outside your primary area of focus.   

Final levelling is determined by education, prior experience, and interview performance.  

Key Responsibilities 

Data Analysis  

Own and structure end-to-end analytical workstreams, translating ambiguous business or economic questions into rigorous, testable analytical approaches.  

Design and implement advanced quantitative and econometric analyses (e.g., regression, causal inference, forecasting, or simulation models) using Python, R, or Stata.  

Independently assess data quality, define methodologies, and select appropriate modeling approaches, making trade-offs under uncertainty.  

Interpret results in a business/economic context, drawing out implications, risks, and limitations—not just reporting outputs.  

Guide and review Associate-level work, ensuring analytical rigor, efficiency, and quality of execution. 

Research  

Lead targeted research efforts to inform problem framing, hypothesis development, and analytical design, not just support it.  

Synthesize economic theory, industry dynamics, and technical constraints into structured hypotheses and analytical plans.  

Critically evaluate sources (academic, regulatory, market data) and determine what materially impacts the case or client decision.  

Connect qualitative insights with quantitative findings to refine direction and challenge initial assumptions. 

Report Writing  

Drive development of clear, structured narratives that link analysis to actionable insights and recommendations.  

Translate complex analytical outputs into persuasive, client-ready materials, tailoring messaging to technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

Own significant sections of client deliverables (reports, memos, presentations), ensuring clarity, logical flow, and defensibility.  

Communicate findings and implications in internal and client discussions, contributing to decision-making and shaping team direction.  

Develop high-impact exhibits that convey both analytical rigor and strategic insight. 

What You’ll Bring 

For this particular role, an MBA is required, along with: 

Education & Experience  

Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Mathematics or a closely related field from a top university (target GPA 3.7+).  

MBA required; Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, or a related field a plus.  

5+ years of relevant experience in consulting, product management, data science, or strategy-oriented roles. 

Demonstrated experience owning discrete projects or workstreams, not just contributing to them.  

Exposure to strategy consulting, economic consulting, investment banking, private equity, or data/technology-driven environments.  

Evidence of academic or leadership excellence (e.g., honors, Dean’s List, leadership roles). 

Analytical Skills  

Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills, with ability to independently structure analytical approaches.  

Proficiency in Python, R, or Stata, with experience working with large, complex datasets.  

Ability to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and actionable insights.  

Solid business and economic intuition 

Communication & Mindset  

Clear, structured communicator with ability to connect analysis to business/economic implications.  

Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving workstreams forward with limited guidance.  

Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members and reviewing work for quality.  

Strong ownership mindset with bias toward action and accountability for outcomes.  

Coachable, growth-oriented, and motivated to develop toward Engagement Manager trajectory.  

Clear interest in litigation consulting and Keystone’s problem space. 

In addition to annual salary, we provide an annual discretionary bonus, 401k contribution, and competitive benefits package. Actual Compensation within the range will depend upon the level the individual is hired into based on their skills, experience, and qualifications.

Annual Salary Range

$140,000—$198,000 USD

At Keystone we believe diversity matters. At every level of our firm, we seek to advance and promote diversity, foster an inclusive culture, and ensure our colleagues have a deep sense of respect and belonging. If you are interested in growing your career with colleagues from varied backgrounds and cultures, consider Keystone.

Senior Lifecycle & CRM Strategy Leader - Contract
Sia
San Francisco, CA, United States

Company Description
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes. 

About Sia Experience-Marketing Advisory 

Sia Experience is the end-to-end marketing and customer experience arm of Sia. Agile and collaborative, our Marketing Advisory Business Line is recognized for delivering high-impact, growth-focused solutions by blending marketing, CX, creative, AI, and deep industry expertise. 

As strategic partners, The Marketing Advisory team empowers clients across technology, luxury, consumer goods, finance, energy, and more to scale operational excellence and drive brand-led growth through AI- and data-driven strategies. Our teams lead full-funnel marketing transformations—from strategy and go-to-market execution to experience design, performance measurement, and sustainable impact. 

It’s an exciting time to join us. SiaX has long been the agency behind some of the world’s biggest brands—now we’re expanding, becoming one of the most recognizable names for companies that demand bold, business-driving creative. We’re shaping SiaX into the go-to agency of the future. This is your chance to be part of that growth, working alongside top-tier creatives, consultants and agency leaders to continuously evolve what a modern, full-service agency can be. Opportunities like this don’t come around often—if you want in on the next level, this is it. 

Job Description
Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work. 

Sia Title: Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)  

Project Title: Senior Lifecycle & CRM Strategy Leader 

Project Length: This is a contract role that could span 6 months with the possibility of extension

Project Hours: 40 hours per week 

Location: Remote 

Rate: $90-110/hr The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location. 

About the role 

We’re seeking a senior lifecycle and CRM leader to build a coordinated customer-growth capability for a digital-presence services business serving entrepreneurs, small businesses, freelancers, and customers building and managing an online presence. The portfolio spans domain registration, website creation, web hosting, professional email, security, and digital marketing solutions. 

The business is evolving from product- and campaign-led communications toward a more integrated lifecycle model. You will assess the current state, define the highest-value customer journeys, and establish a practical roadmap connecting customer and account data, setup and service signals, marketing technology, content, measurement, and cross-functional execution. 

The work should help customers move from purchasing a domain or digital service to successfully establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence. It should strengthen service activation, time to value, complementary-service adoption, renewal readiness, retention, expansion, and win-back. You will serve as a senior advisor while remaining hands-on in shaping the first wave of journeys, tests, and operating practices. 

What You’ll Do 

• Assess the end-to-end digital-presence lifecycle. Map the experience from domain search and purchase through account setup, website creation and launch, hosting and professional email activation, security adoption, ongoing management, renewal, cancellation or lapse, win-back, and expansion into relevant adjacent services. 

• Build the lifecycle strategy and roadmap. Define lifecycle stages, customer and business outcomes, journey priorities, and a sequenced plan balancing immediate improvements with longer-term data, technology, content, and operating-model needs. 

• Design high-value customer journeys. Develop coordinated programs for onboarding, service activation, website launch, customer education, renewal preparation, lapse prevention, retention, service recovery, win-back, and expansion into complementary digital-presence services. 

• Advance segmentation and trigger strategy. Define actionable audiences and triggers using customer profile, domain and service purchases, setup milestones, website launch status, account activity, billing and renewal status, support interactions, engagement, and service-portfolio signals. 

• Connect CRM, service, and channel data. Determine the data, identity, consent, automation, and integration capabilities required to coordinate experiences across email, web, account experiences, service interactions, and other available channels. 

• Improve personalization and next-best-action decisions. Deliver relevant setup guidance, website-launch support, education, security and renewal reminders, complementary-service recommendations, and re-engagement based on where customers are in building and managing their online presence. 

• Establish experimentation and measurement. Define baselines, test plans, controls, and reporting for setup completion, service activation, website launch, time to value, multi-service relationships, engagement, renewal, lapse prevention, retention, win-back, customer value, and incremental commercial impact. 

• Create the lifecycle operating model. Clarify decision rights, ownership, intake, prioritization, approvals, production, reporting, and optimization across marketing, product, ecommerce, customer care, data, analytics, creative, and technology. 

• Move the first wave into delivery. Translate recommendations into journey maps, briefs, audience and trigger definitions, content requirements, test designs, measurement plans, and a prioritized delivery backlog. 

• Build sustainable internal capability. Create reusable frameworks, governance, documentation, and working rhythms that enable internal teams to continuously improve lifecycle programs. 

What Success Looks Like

 

• A clear lifecycle and CRM maturity assessment covering journeys, data, segmentation, triggers, channels, technology, content, measurement, and team capability. 

• A prioritized roadmap tied to customers establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence, with measurable outcomes across time to value, renewal, retention, expansion, and win-back. 

• A defined first wave of journeys with owners, requirements, dependencies, tests, and measurement. 

• A more connected experience for customers holding one or multiple services across domains, websites, hosting, professional email, security, digital marketing, billing, renewals, and support. 

• Clear governance and operating rhythms across the functions supporting the customer experience. 

• Internal teams equipped to sustain and improve the lifecycle capability. 

Qualifications
• Approximately 15+ years across lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, customer engagement, marketing automation, customer journey, or growth CRM. 

• Senior Director or VP-level experience advising executives and influencing cross-functional decisions. 

• Experience building a lifecycle capability from a low-maturity starting point, not only optimizing an established program. 

• Deep experience with recurring-revenue digital services, especially domain registration, web hosting, website building, professional email, online security, digital marketing, ecommerce enablement, or adjacent small-business services. 

• Ability to connect customer strategy with data, identity, consent, marketing technology, service signals, support interactions, content, execution, and measurement. 

• Experience designing journeys from purchase through setup, activation, launch, ongoing value realization, renewal, expansion, retention, service recovery, lapse prevention, and win-back. 

• Fluency in segmentation, event-based triggers, journey orchestration, personalization, experimentation, and incremental measurement. 

• Experience managing lifecycle complexity across customers who may own a single service or a portfolio of interconnected digital-presence services. 

• Ability to balance executive counsel with hands-on development of journey maps, briefs, audience definitions, test plans, roadmaps, and operating processes. 

• Availability for a fully remote, full-time contract engagement aligned to Pacific Time working hours. 

Additional Information
Work Authorization 

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
